lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Somalia in 2018. Geographic data representing different IPC scenarios (food insecurity phases) were compiled into GeoJSON format for February, June, and October 2018 snapshots, providing spatial representation of acute food insecurity impacts across administrative areas.
